_comment: Draft entry for the curated list (iasiv5/dsh-m registry.json). The curated list is hand-curated by the dsh-m author; a community PR may propose an entry. Copy this object into the `plugins` array of registry.json. Text must obey docs/registry-copy-guide.md: <=60 full-width units, Chinese, no precise numbers without a freshness mechanism, relations only in the trailing sentence. Only include `verified` for coupled entries; omit it (and use the '版本无关' wording) if the plugin survives DSH upgrades without per-release adaptation.
name: DSH Prompt Enhance
